For C4 (linked to PF3, checking neutral facilitator requirement): the settlement sets neutral_facilitator_required to true and includes a commitment with detail mentioning a neutral facilitator — verify whether C4 checks a different field name such as requires_neutral_facilitator or expects the value in a different location. For C7 (linked to PF2, checking work_request_channel to shared_project_channel): the settlement sets work_request_channel to "shared project channel" (with spaces) — verify whether C7 requires the exact string "shared_project_channel" (with underscores). Adjust C1, C4, and C7 check wording or field expectations to match how the model naturally encodes these decisions. Strengthen the shared_context consultation norm to require that A2 use a reveal action for PF1 specifically, ensuring consistent formal disclosure across all rollouts and preventing the C2/P1 failures seen in rollout 1.
